status: MOCKUP art, internal only - not wired into the game
motion: D2-style scripted (no physics): axe flies out 6 px/f (180 px/s) to min(150 px, cursor), piercing; then returns to the hand easing 2 -> 7 px/f, piercing again; one axe at a time, hands alternate. The axe flies at hand height (hero feet - 12 px); its ground shadow stays on the floor under it.

direction.axe_spin / spin_smear: 16-frame spin loop, index += 2 per game frame (45 deg/f); flipX when travelling left
direction.trail_dir16: row = screen velocity direction (row + 8 on the way back), 4-frame wobble loop at 50 ms
direction.placement: axe_spin / spin_smear / trail pivots = axe centre; shadow under the axe at the ground point; hit at enemy body centre (feet - 12); catch_flash + ring_mask at the hand

visual_size.axe: about 22 px long (v1 17 px, x1.2 for readability at range)
visual_size.trail: one ribbon up to 36 px behind the axe, max 7.5 px wide at the axe, tapering to a dithered tail (v1: 4 parallel streak lines = the 'comb')
visual_size.hitbox_note: Visual only. HM sets the projectile hit radius (suggest 8 px around the axe centre).

layers.role: base: the flying axe (steel blade with a blood band, wood haft, back spike so the spin reads)
layers.sort: Y-sorted at the axe's ground point (+1)

layers.role: solid gradient band swept 210 deg behind the blade (bright at the blade, dithering out), same index / flip as axe_spin
ONE continuous tapered ribbon (white-hot core -> steel -> dark edge) wobbling with the spin, 2 blood flecks; replaces the v1 comb of parallel streaks
ground shadow under the flying axe: ragged, dithered blob (frame 0 ~11x4, frame 1 ~9x3), not a clean disc
each pierce (out and back, once per enemy per pass): white star + 7 steel sparks + 5 blood flecks along the axe velocity
flash when the axe returns to the hand: white cross star + 8 steel shards flung out (no drawn ring); also usable at release
optional distortion ring at the catch (and release) - a mask for the distortion pass only, never drawn
layers.material: screen-space distortion, uv offset = normalize(grad(blur(mask,1.5))) * mask * 2 art px

glow_runtime: glow_rgb = blur(glow_mask.a / 255, sigma) * tint * gain, additive (One One), same frame (+row) as its sprite

timeline_frames_30fps.-6..-1: hero throw wind-up (t1517 melee strip poses 0-2)
timeline_frames_30fps.0: release at the hand (+ optional catch_flash f2-6 small + ring_mask); axe_spin index 0, trail starts
timeline_frames_30fps.1..n: out at 6 px/f; hit_dir16 on each enemy crossed
timeline_frames_30fps.turn: at max range the axe hangs 2 f (spin continues), trail row flips
timeline_frames_30fps.catch: catch_flash f0-6 + ring_mask f0-5 at the hand; hide the axe; next throw uses the other hand
